selection.premotor: ConnectsTo those motor neurons with roiInfo containing VNC
selection.descending: superclass=descending_neuron, VNC ConnectsTo the premotor/motor set, not already included
selection.proofread_and_nt: status=Traced and consensusNt IS NOT NULL
selection.synapse_floor: keep a neuron only if it retains a VNC connection of >=5 synapses inside the set

note: Candidate front-leg population is 4,385 traced neurons with consensusNt. After requiring a VNC connection of at least 5 synapses inside that set, 4,301 remain. The paper reports 4,310. The 9-neuron gap is unresolved, so this set is not their W_table and its median is not computed.
